results.title: Nicole Kidman says she had 'different view' of future before divorce from Keith Urban
results.description: Nicole Kidman filed for divorce from Keith Urban on September 30, citing irreconcilable differences. Their divorce was later finalized in January.

results.title: Frank Beard, ZZ Top's Drummer, Dies at 77
results.description: Frank Beard, ZZ Top's drummer for over 50 years, died at 77 at his Texas ranch while in hospice care with family by his side.
